Мисс София побледнела, но краска вернулась к ней, когда она узнала, что тот человек не ранен.", "Мисс Шарлотта", "Как только мне удалось увести Бака вдвоём к кукурузным закромам под деревьями, я сказал:"]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "043-021-0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“Did you want to kill him, Buck?”", "sha256": "2cd1fe971a58ac999c4271375456dd9c5e22d23b4c6cf16d022e999976030642", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[20]", "source_html": "“Did you want to kill him, Buck?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0021", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, I bet I did.”", "sha256": "1f8e54d1cf4e3761f505a4075efeae218536949d4167d0776d628e7f29084b5c", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[21]", "source_html": "“Well, I bet I did.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0022", "tag": "p", "text": "“What did he do to you?”", "sha256": "fdfac635cd31de2feb129538363e2b5ed083e01a00b01eb3c8f5d4000cb1e8f6", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[22]", "source_html": "“What did he do to you?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“Him? He never done nothing to me.”", "sha256": "b6f4d5ff104699a5ab7add41282ac897672587929c13cfdc16bbfbc7dfcc9efd", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[23]", "source_html": "“Him? He never done nothing to me.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, then, what did you want to kill him for?”", "sha256": "262ad9390b76ee67091d88eb1f7c3bef129bdbea4025e94ce2e8a73738e61b6a", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[24]", "source_html": "“Well, then, what did you want to kill him for?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0025", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, nothing—only it’s on account of the feud.”", "sha256": "7c2045015adb9ddcb7e438b8a24ce349bd0917d4d988a635256b4ed3eeb32fc8", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[25]", "source_html": "“Why, nothing—only it’s on account of the feud.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“What’s a feud?”", "sha256": "71aeb127ebc132c9cbfc91ac6e03773112a50baa00ef28a6aaebde955011a044", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[26]", "source_html": "“What’s a feud?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, where was you raised? Don’t you know what a feud is?”", "sha256": "5f3ca9663eadf33acd2dbcbeba1bbce7fa0e4ed2b9609dee54e06513e286979b", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[27]", "source_html": "“Why, where was you raised? Don’t you know what a feud is?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“Never heard of it before—tell me about it.”", "sha256": "097b1644d1e1d58415c4eb734fac96d42ccfe8af34bf94666a8f9441db10931d", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[28]", "source_html": "“Never heard of it before—tell me about it.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well,” says Buck, “a feud is this way. A man has a quarrel with another man, and kills him; then that other man’s brother kills him; then the other brothers, on both sides, goes for one another; then the cousins chip in—and by-and-by everybody’s killed off, and there ain’t no more feud. But it’s kind of slow, and takes a long time.”", "sha256": "d8f6adfe3cbb3c1b8ba41d73c1d470e19c62482713d5ed772ededcb27d1e0f1c", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[29]", "source_html": "“Well,” says Buck, “a feud is this way. A man has a quarrel with another man, and kills him; then that other man’s brother kills him; then the other brothers, on both sides, goes for one another; then the cousins chip in—and by-and-by everybody’s killed off, and there ain’t no more feud. But it’s kind of slow, and takes a long time.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0030", "tag": "p", "text": "“Has this one been going on long, Buck?”", "sha256": "38ff2fae0911e9791b612312c0120723a651888b9e35af57b6c465ec9c746f0b", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[30]", "source_html": "“Has this one been going on long, Buck?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0031", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, I should reckon! It started thirty year ago, or som’ers along there. There was trouble ’bout something, and then a lawsuit to settle it; and the suit went agin one of the men, and so he up and shot the man that won the suit—which he would naturally do, of course. Anybody would.”", "sha256": "8a316bfdad3cbe4662d9a767502fb2207a5ad42c4564f7a3bcc5ed88c3eb14f2", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[31]", "source_html": "“Well, I should reckon! It started thirty year ago, or som’ers along there. There was trouble ’bout something, and then a lawsuit to settle it; and the suit went agin one of the men, and so he up and shot the man that won the suit—which he would naturally do, of course. Anybody would.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0032", "tag": "p", "text": "“What was the trouble about, Buck?—land?”", "sha256": "2bb4095d8f7756b66031e15ff989e6cb8acd2d8eb6be70e3275acda99529a8ed", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[32]", "source_html": "“What was the trouble about, Buck?—land?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0033", "tag": "p", "text": "“I reckon maybe—I don’t know.”", "sha256": "dc3a1366811df22037bba8773c1df17ef40ca7c2a13e05e05e414fd37e27e70c", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[33]", "source_html": "“I reckon maybe—I don’t know.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0034", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, who done the shooting? Was it a Grangerford or a Shepherdson?”", "sha256": "09c69274a4004d2b7e935473de407d61721f83123a49565b4c979eaa891c5331", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[34]", "source_html": "“Well, who done the shooting? Was it a Grangerford or a Shepherdson?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“Laws, how do I know? It was so long ago.”", "sha256": "f1bdf821646aa17cfa6a567329f0e0900ac712157fbb5ba1aedf62288f254f64", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[35]", "source_html": "“Laws, how do I know? It was so long ago.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“Don’t anybody know?”", "sha256": "0cad2d614d1d4dc37947d8744a0dc6d84d8bd742e424a9b0b3b25e074fabfca5", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[36]", "source_html": "“Don’t anybody know?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0037", "tag": "p", "text": "“Oh, yes, pa knows, I reckon, and some of the other old people; but they don’t know now what the row was about in the first place.”", "sha256": "204651f861c2b91e98f185301e2e974db68a06e7e5de7e458b86053c17ea8e14", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[37]", "source_html": "“Oh, yes, pa knows, I reckon, and some of the other old people; but they don’t know now what the row was about in the first place.”"}, {"id": "043-021-0038", "tag": "p", "text": "“Has there been many killed, Buck?”", "sha256": "c6916441f1d9c4e8d8e5d53b02cf4aa202fb9cbf36133d8677e36fdc290984f7", "source_location": "div.chapter[23]/*[38]", "source_html": "“Has there been many killed, Buck?”"}, {"id": "043-021-0039", "tag": "p", "text": "“Yes; right smart chance of funerals. Bob’s been carved up some with a bowie, and Tom’s been hurt once or twice.”"}], "draft_rows": [{"source_id": "043-021-0020", "target": "«Ты хотел его убить, Бак?»", "source_sha256": "2cd1fe971a58ac999c4271375456dd9c5e22d23b4c6cf16d022e999976030642", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0020", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9a9397907c3786393d3f8a745ff40a11cd9bfd70a2c4fd62d1d19da56f2051d1"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0021", "target": "«Ну, я уверен, что так и было».", "source_sha256": "1f8e54d1cf4e3761f505a4075efeae218536949d4167d0776d628e7f29084b5c", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0021", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "12198114696e176b2acf89e44dc1d5aa81d83cce8549f5e5db938e2cbd076272"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0022", "target": "«Что он с тобой сделал?»", "source_sha256": "fdfac635cd31de2feb129538363e2b5ed083e01a00b01eb3c8f5d4000cb1e8f6", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0022", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5162df973b7c138bdc59898af8863ce0c5984ef52f60eb3ff32dea012f8e070c"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0023", "target": "«Его? Он мне ничего не сделал».", "source_sha256": "b6f4d5ff104699a5ab7add41282ac897672587929c13cfdc16bbfbc7dfcc9efd", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0023", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "dbe262f7859c44f80f6dfc1420ec82ca751892f12d5b449f764f109a9fcb5222"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0024", "target": "«Ну, тогда зачем ты хотел его убить?»", "source_sha256": "262ad9390b76ee67091d88eb1f7c3bef129bdbea4025e94ce2e8a73738e61b6a", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0024", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "eb556b239841c369718e3274f1e08e58ed4e6424ff1232cf0519155ed9eb3317"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0025", "target": "«Да ничего — просто это из-за вражды».", "source_sha256": "7c2045015adb9ddcb7e438b8a24ce349bd0917d4d988a635256b4ed3eeb32fc8", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0025", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ee7e0bce5f0cb3235ddcaeb173aca2564238d94c0cc79ace757a32bfdf1aebcb"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0026", "target": "«Что такое вражда?»", "source_sha256": "71aeb127ebc132c9cbfc91ac6e03773112a50baa00ef28a6aaebde955011a044", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0026", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "e0f7a242f9cd531eb751539ade78318bc9b21e65597cebbb8b998a73563e5761"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0027", "target": "«Да где же ты вырос? Разве ты не знаешь, что такое вражда?»", "source_sha256": "5f3ca9663eadf33acd2dbcbeba1bbce7fa0e4ed2b9609dee54e06513e286979b", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0027", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "35ffc5e344325f261733f5732e87020a9c5e822f4980d4d4fa5d29b6576d9ece"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0028", "target": "«Никогда об этом не слышал — расскажи мне об этом».", "source_sha256": "097b1644d1e1d58415c4eb734fac96d42ccfe8af34bf94666a8f9441db10931d", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0028", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "2505f1af07c884868732c885fc0ba3361da860b065cca9c8350d8d7548a8afff"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0029", "target": "«Ну, — говорит Бак, — вражда выглядит так. Один человек ссорится с другим и убивает его; потом брат того человека убивает его; потом остальные братья с обеих сторон набрасываются друг на друга; потом в дело вступают двоюродные братья — и со временем всех убивают, и вражды больше нет. Но это довольно медленно и занимает много времени».", "source_sha256": "d8f6adfe3cbb3c1b8ba41d73c1d470e19c62482713d5ed772ededcb27d1e0f1c", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0029", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a01c60aa242ceea0f4ac5eb5cea2feb94eb71bdaf69b3144ecbcb49d36707676"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0030", "target": "«Это уже давно продолжается, Бак?»", "source_sha256": "38ff2fae0911e9791b612312c0120723a651888b9e35af57b6c465ec9c746f0b", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3f6150cb5ecef9c2ca186352efbcc8d01717ef8925e4cdce8fbea47623d9fe2a"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0031", "target": "«Ну, я бы так и подумал! Всё началось тридцать лет назад, или где-то в том районе. Были какие-то неприятности, а потом судебный процесс, чтобы всё уладить; и дело обернулось против одного из мужчин, и вот он взял и застрелил того, кто выиграл дело — что, естественно, было вполне логично. Любой бы так поступил».", "source_sha256": "8a316bfdad3cbe4662d9a767502fb2207a5ad42c4564f7a3bcc5ed88c3eb14f2", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "04ce464e193043077aac8bf5f28108c43d21c348ec98189e5694af72e60d2d97"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0032", "target": "«В чём была проблема, Бак? — земля?»", "source_sha256": "2bb4095d8f7756b66031e15ff989e6cb8acd2d8eb6be70e3275acda99529a8ed", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0032", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "976f25bf0916d9994154d62dd65daf63087965eff69ec38ef30e89dd8bca357c"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0033", "target": "«Думаю, может быть… не знаю».", "source_sha256": "dc3a1366811df22037bba8773c1df17ef40ca7c2a13e05e05e414fd37e27e70c", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0033", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "de1405387ee8c3a5b69317d1a85e6725c49e16d86fe32c9c397fd24d726bc3ff"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0034", "target": "«Ну, кто же стрелял? Это был кто-то из Грейнджерфордов или из Шепердсонов?»", "source_sha256": "09c69274a4004d2b7e935473de407d61721f83123a49565b4c979eaa891c5331", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0034", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fcd7dd07e36bfa4ee6337a3d56a3c65da77a7af1a229d869d602991322631aba"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0035", "target": "«Боже, откуда мне знать? Это было так давно».", "source_sha256": "f1bdf821646aa17cfa6a567329f0e0900ac712157fbb5ba1aedf62288f254f64", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0035", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7167343972900f6daafec5eeb71dcad7cb743e33723056652badc1f2b34d8652"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0036", "target": "«Никто не знает?»", "source_sha256": "0cad2d614d1d4dc37947d8744a0dc6d84d8bd742e424a9b0b3b25e074fabfca5", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0036", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d6d8b948da12871fc7d919e5357c3d94e013dc8769cd4d84500b9d5c2ecbe73c"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0037", "target": "«О, да, папа, наверное, знает, и некоторые другие старики; но они теперь не знают, из-за чего вообще поднялся весь этот шум».", "source_sha256": "204651f861c2b91e98f185301e2e974db68a06e7e5de7e458b86053c17ea8e14", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0037", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "71983b7ffd60f50de96c3be863bdc6550b14e755954baddda1caed5bc13394c4"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0038", "target": "«Много ли погибших, Бак?»", "source_sha256": "c6916441f1d9c4e8d8e5d53b02cf4aa202fb9cbf36133d8677e36fdc290984f7", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0038", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4ecf6f1130076a4599537d165e4aec3000d0648e52d0d2eb2ee8cb752e5bd8c3"}, {"source_id": "043-021-0039", "target": "«Да, похороны — дело довольно частое. Но они не всегда убивают. У папы в теле несколько дробин, но он не обращает на это внимания, потому что он и так не весит много. Боба немного порезали ножом Боуи, а Том был ранен раз или два».", "source_sha256": "b2c82b330c7de738c995841a0e3f125307ffd0cca2b68dede416d40857fdc31d", "target_id": "ru-043-021-0039", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a358a30ef61af5f7111f5ca39f7eaf3e7e6bb20f5dfd4697beeb96fc7a9f61c3"}]}
